caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a wall-mounted oil lamp or lantern, illustrated in grayscale on a beige paper background. The lamp has a rounded, shallow bowl-like base with a large circular backplate and an attached ring at the top, presumably for hanging or carrying. Two upright elements, possibly candleholders or wicks with attached chains, are positioned on the upper right side of the lamp. The lighting and shading suggest a metallic or polished surface. In the bottom left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified outline of the same object, providing a basic side profile. The drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border, and there is a signature "M. de Ferriante" in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Lamp
